A compact motorized loading device. Turn it on (right-click) and it seats rounds into any empty magazine you carry, one at a time.
It needs a battery: shipped without one, so insert a cell first. Draws about 1/10 of a flashlight; swaps in a fresh battery from your pack when it runs dry, and switches itself off if there is none.

Container capacity (slots) of the HM Tactical Backpack (all 4 colours). 0 = use the item script default (49). Applies live to backpacks in inventory, on the ground or on zombies. Default: 49.
Weight reduction %% for HM tactical backpacks (all 4 colors). 0 = none, 100 = full. Applies immediately. Default: 95.

Enable this if the tooltip conflicts with weapon-stats mods. This MOD takes over the weapon tooltip to color it (tier color / orange effects / star affixes / golden numbers); that takeover is structurally mutually exclusive with other takeover-style mods. When enabled, this MOD no longer takes over and tooltips return to vanilla style (tier and affix text still shown, just uncolored). Default: off.

Zombies dying inside Willowbrook have this chance to additionally drop one easter-egg weapon: Meow Laser Gun / Seven-Treasure Hunt / Xiaomidi's Salty Fish Greatsword / the Journey-to-the-West set (Ruyi Jingu Bang, Nine-Toothed Rake, Demon-Subduing Staff, Tang Monk's Kasaya). 0.2 = 1 in 500 (default, same feel as before), 1 = 1%%. Set 0 to disable. Default: 0.2.
Toggles a small chance for special weapons and firearms in containers inside Willowbrook rooms only; other map regions are unaffected. Already-spawned containers keep their loot. Default: off.

When on, effect weapons carry their unique effects (holy flame, chain lightning, shockwave, etc.). When off, all weapon effects are disabled - effect weapons become plain vanilla-stat weapons, and their tooltip descriptions are hidden too. Default: off.
Toggles firearms and suppressor loot INSIDE Willowbrook only (four gun rooms, containers, zombie corpses). Other regions are unaffected. Default: off.

Volume of the legendary drop sound played when a special weapon or firearm lands on the ground (Uber-tier weapons use their own dedicated sound). 0 = completely silent (same as off). Drag the slider to adjust; the "Preview" button on the right plays the sound at the current volume (hold Shift and click to preview the Uber-tier sound). Client-side playback only; the drop itself is unaffected. Default: 10.
Toggle effect weapon spawns in special map rooms (Ashbringer / Maiduo spear / epoxy stick / Hanjian rooms). Only affects newly generated containers. Default: on.

If enabled, new players automatically learn all custom forge recipes (Tangdao/Liuyedao/Miaodao/HanHuanshoudao/Taishanbaohuan/Yuchangjian/Modao/Zilongchangqiang/Mashuo/Daxialongque). If disabled, the recipes cannot be learned or crafted. Default: on.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the NP4292G pistol. 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent, 200 = twice as loud. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched, so zombie attraction is exactly as before. When a suppressor is attached, the suppressor volume takes over (not stacked). The "Preview" button on the right plays it at the slider's current volume. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the QBZ192 assault rifle. 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent, 200 = twice as loud. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched, so zombie attraction is exactly as before. When a suppressor is attached, the suppressor volume takes over (not stacked). The "Preview" button on the right plays it at the slider's current volume. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the Type 97-1 pump shotgun (the loudest of the four). 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent, 200 = twice as loud. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched, so zombie attraction is exactly as before. When a suppressor is attached, the suppressor volume takes over (not stacked). The "Preview" button on the right plays it at the slider's current volume. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the West2Asnape marksman rifle. 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent, 200 = twice as loud. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched, so zombie attraction is exactly as before. When a suppressor is attached, the suppressor volume takes over (not stacked). The "Preview" button on the right plays it at the slider's current volume. Default: 100.
Container capacity (slots) of the HM Tactical Drop-Leg Rig (all 4 colours). 0 = use the item script default (6). Applies live. Default: 6.
Weight reduction %% for HM leg bags (all 4 colors). 0 = none, 100 = full. Applies immediately. Default: 92.
Container capacity of the Niuma bag (cqnmBackpack). 0 = use script default (63). Applies immediately. Default: 63.
Weight reduction %% for the Niuma bag. 0 = none, 100 = full. Applies immediately. Default: 95.
Plays this row's sound at the volume currently set on the slider (reads the slider, not the saved value).

Local gunshot volume percentage while a WB suppressor part is attached. 100 = the original suppressed volume (NP4292G 4 / QBZ192 5 / West2Asnape 5 / Type 97-1 6), 0 = silent, 200 = twice as loud. Only the volume you hear changes - the suppressed SoundRadius stays as-is (all below the 50 threshold the zombie population uses, so no off-screen hordes). The "Preview" button plays a suppressed shot (QBZ192 timbre). Default: 100.

Police zombies spawning inside Willowbrook have this chance to spawn already WEARING a full black set: Type 21 Combat Boots, Type 21 Tactical Vest, HM Tactical Drop-Leg Rig and HM Tactical Backpack. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 25.
Container capacity (slots) of the Type 21 Tactical Vest (all 4 colours). 0 = use the item script default (9). Applies live. Default: 9.

Army zombies spawning inside Willowbrook (in one random colour: starry sky, desert or snow white) have this chance to spawn already WEARING a full mod gear set: Type 21 Combat Boots, Type 21 Tactical Vest, HM Tactical Drop-Leg Rig and HM Tactical Backpack. Set 0 to disable. Default: 25.
Weight reduction %% for Type-21 tactical vests (all 4 colors). 0 = none, 100 = full. Applies immediately. Default: 90.

Zombies dying inside Willowbrook have this chance to drop a special weapon on their corpse: melee effect weapons (normal zombies) or a firearm (army zombies). 0.001 = 1 in 100,000 (default), 1 = 1%%. Set 0 to disable.

[Center of Attention]: while carried (bags included), zombies within 200 tiles keep coming to you

The nine-toothed rake of Zhu Bajie
[Pervert]: female zombies within 5 tiles swoon and fall, again and again

A rubber chicken

[Purify]: %1%% chance on hit to trigger Holy Flame, igniting up to 12 nearby zombies (10s cooldown)

[Weifeng]: downed zombies have a %1%% chance to be executed
[Momentum]: %1%% chance on hit to restore %2%% endurance; long blunt XP doubled
[Stun]: %1%% chance on hit to stagger the target for 2 seconds
[Blade Master]: every attack strikes a vital point, making the target bleed for a small amount of damage each second for %1 seconds. You deal %2%% more damage to bleeding enemies

A meow laser gun from the future.
[Old Wu]: infinite energy, no magazine needed; negligible damage (~0.1-0.5), but it meows.
[Wan Ren Di]: %1%% chance on hit to strike every enemy within a %2-tile radius for damage; the more enemies around, the higher this damage (+%3%% per extra enemy, up to +%4%%)
[Resonance]: %1%% chance on hit - next strike always crits, dealing +%2%% damage (ignores all debuffs), lasts 6s
[Sweep]: %1%% chance on hit to sweep, striking up to %2 enemies
[Impervious]: Corpse-gas sickness has no effect on you.
[Sword Saint]: Press %1 to unleash a fierce sword slash - all zombies within 2 tiles take continuous damage for 2 seconds (every 0.2s, low damage with hit stagger, 10s cooldown).
[Dormant] Awakens First Over the Wall at %1 / %2 kills
[First Over the Wall x%2] extra attack +%2 - %3%% instant slay
- of which affix +%1 (the other x%2 comes from tier)

A dried salted fish, inexplicably hard as iron.
[Fish Slap]: deals no damage, but every hit slips a zombie; an insult to zombiekind.
8x telescopic scope, mounts on marksman rifles

Greatly reduces gunshot noise.
Right-click the matching gun to install or remove.
[Nimble Blade]: every one of your attacks deals a second hit for %1%% of the first hit's damage, and it can crit
[Guidao]: Hits from behind deal %1x damage; %2%% chance on hit to slay instantly
[Fearless]: never panicked while wielding; +100%% attack speed, restores %1%% stamina per second
[Self-Restraint]: +%1%% attack speed against sprinters; +%2%% critical chance and critical damage against normal and slow zombies.

The monk's demon-subduing staff
[Hardworking]: hitting zombies grants Fitness XP
Battery dead (turn it off, insert a new battery, turn it on)

Forged as Longque, to bear Great Xia's might
[Tiandao]: While held, zombies ganging up on you are struck down - you can never be surrounded or executed!
[Concord]: Next strike always crits for bonus damage!

Light endures, reborn from ash
[Holy Flame]: 25%% chance on hit to ignite foes, burning them for 0.5 damage per second for 6 seconds
[Purify]: 1%% chance on hit to trigger holy fire, igniting up to 12 zombies around you (10s cooldown)
[Sanctified]: Each kill rolls back zombie-infection progress by 5%%; reaching zero fully purges the virus

Sword is not for slaughter, but for honor
[King's Way]: 10%% chance on hit to knock down all enemies within a 3-tile radius
[Weifeng]: downed zombies have a 2%% chance to be executed
[Noble]: Long Blade XP gain doubled while wielded

Wield steel for righteousness
[First Over the Wall]: With more than 4 zombies around you, gain +1 extra attack target, and you have a very high chance to slay one zombie outright

Modern craft - a real brawler
[Momentum]: 10%% chance on hit to restore 2%% endurance; polearm XP doubled
[Stun]: 10%% chance on hit to stagger the target for 2 seconds

One sweeping stroke, all filth fades away

This spear is my vow, never to part
[Resonance]: 20%% chance on hit for the next strike to crit with +200%% crit damage (6s)
[Sweep]: 15%% chance on hit to sweep, striking up to 6 enemies in one swing

Strength to lift mountains, spirit unmatched
[Wan Ren Di]: 10%% chance on hit to strike every enemy within a 2-tile radius for damage; the more enemies around, the higher this damage (+20%% per extra enemy, up to +200%%)

Miao Dao drawn to fend raiders; Qi's craft guards the folk
[Bloodied Fury]: When enough enemies are around you, you lose no fatigue and no endurance

Where Mo Dao falls, men and horses crumble
[Last Stand]: Fear and wound pain will never lower your attack speed or damage

Warrior's blade, it spares the innocent
[Nimble Blade]: every one of your attacks deals a second hit for 30%% of the first hit's damage, and it can crit

Ward spirits at rest, shield its bearer in war
[Junzi the Gentleman]: every hit cripples the zombie's legs - it can never walk or run again, only crawl.
